data.descriptionEn:
Check the price before running, use the cost query: https://www.runninghub.cn/call api thirdPartyCallFeeTitle
Platform runtime is charged per second (RH coins) Third-party API single call fee (wallet balance)
Platform runs standard tasks (24G VRAM): consumes 0.2 RH coins per second, platform runs Plus tasks (48G VRAM): consumes 0.4 RH coins per second
This application supports the arbitrary fusion of 9 images, currently offering 5 usage opportunities per day for experience. For specific prices, check the link above. Banana is not open-sourced at the moment, the price is relatively high but it is quite useful.

Benefit! Click the avatar and fill in my invitation code jyprlu70! You can get 500 points! The system also gives 100 points every day! Come and take advantage!
